value.rationale: The equivalence changes the mathematical interpretation of a specific sufficient condition in active 2026 research on deduction-detachment and CEP. Instead of relying solely on a cheap counterexample, the result proves a complete universal collapse, isolates precisely why the proposed nonadditive witness fails, and classifies/enumerates every finite model of that condition with a sharp bottom-value refinement. It separates failure of the claimed strictness from the independent existence of nonadditive CEP operators, a necessary distinction for future constructions. The usual characterization of additive BAOs alone is not asserted as new.
